Web · Wisconsin Creative

Schedule recent activity strip

The Schedule chrome no longer leads with standing Crew needed / Gear gaps / Data quality badges or full-width combine and unreleased-crew banners. It shows recent crew and calendar changes, with those exceptions as quiet rows.

Visual comparison

Not a matched pair. The before image is the operator crop of the noisy chrome on 2026-09-18. The after captures are authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000/schedule as Erik Role ADMIN. Viewports and page chrome differ; do not treat pixel deltas as measured.

What changed, and why

Default strip is activity, not standing queues

Was

Tone-sorted badges capped at three, so Crew needed / Gear gaps / Data quality occupied the chrome on every visit.

Now

Newest crew and calendar-sync rows occupy the strip. Queue totals stay in Details.

Exceptions are quiet rows

Was

A full-width orange combine banner and a destructive Alert for every unreleased crew sat above the list.

Now

One unreleased-crew row and one combine row share the activity list, with Review still opening the existing crew sheet or combine preview.

The strip sits above the scroll block

Was

Recent activity lived in the document flow above the list, so a today-anchored timeline hid it until you scrolled to the oldest events.

Now

It pins with the title and filters. Day headers and the today anchor measure the combined sticky bottom, so the timeline runs underneath.

Red/green schedule diffs

Was

Expanded sync rows were plain text from → to lines.

Now

Old values are struck in red and new values are green, matching ActivityTimeline field diffs.

Things to know

  • Before and after are not matched viewports. The before image is the operator crop of the problem; after is Preview desktop.
  • Preview change-history newest rows are from Sep 5–7, so the strip shows calendar updates with date labels rather than minutes-ago assignment edits.
  • The strip now pins with the title and filters, so programmatic scroll-into-view of the activity section is no longer required to see it on a today-anchored list.
  • The local Preview server was left running at http://127.0.0.1:3000.
